representation: HTTP transport probe (no artifact was patched)
notes: TRANSPORT PROBE, NOT A SIZE MEASUREMENT. Most fields of this schema do not apply and are null by the schema's own rule. QUESTION: what does a client actually meet when downloading a GitHub release asset, given that the plugin bounds the redirect chain and refuses an HTTPS->HTTP hop, and those bounds should come from measurement rather than from a guess? RESULT: exactly one redirect. github.com answers 302 with a cross-host Location on release-assets.githubusercontent.com; that host answers 200 from Azure Blob storage (server: Windows-Azure-Blob/1.0) with a Content-Length present. HTTPS throughout. The CDN URL is signed and carries an expiry roughly an hour out (se= parameter), so it is not a stable link and must not be recorded in a manifest -- manifests name the github.com URL, which is stable, and the redirect is resolved per download. THREE CONSEQUENCES FOR THE CLIENT, all already satisfied: (1) the default redirect budget of 5 covers a one-hop chain with room to spare; (2) the hop is cross-HOST, so any policy pinned to the manifest's host would break every real GitHub download -- the plugin deliberately has no such policy; (3) the chain never leaves HTTPS, so the no-downgrade rule costs nothing on the happy path while still refusing a redirect that would drop TLS. It also confirms Content-Length is present on the final response, which is what makes the advisory pre-read size check useful rather than dead code -- though the streaming counter remains the thing that actually enforces the bound. CORRECTION THIS PRODUCED: crates/plugin/src/http.rs documented the redirect target as objects.githubusercontent.com. The observed host is release-assets.githubusercontent.com. The code was unaffected -- it pins no host -- but the comment was stale and is now dated and sourced. SCOPE: one asset, one repository, one day, unauthenticated, HEAD requests only. GitHub may serve differently by region, by asset size, or to authenticated clients. The signature and jwt query parameters are redacted in the log; they are short-lived credentials for that one URL.
artifact_provenance: No artifact was produced. `curl -sIL --max-redirs 10` against a public release asset of cli/cli v2.97.0, chosen because it is a large, widely-mirrored, unauthenticated public download. Read-only: nothing was created, uploaded or modified on GitHub.
